style="text;html=1;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#12263F;spacingLeft=6;" value="1 Runner starts the Job through ARM (public)
2 Job executes INSIDE snet-aca
3 Job calls the backend on its internal FQDN
4 Backend calls the Foundry Agent via private endpoint
5 Agent reads/writes its BYO stores, all private
6 Exit code + console log stream give the verdict

Negative control: the same probes run from the
public runner and MUST fail. That failure is the
evidence the isolation is real." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="400" x="84" y="768" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lgKey" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5A6B7D;" value="━━ control plane (public) ━━ private data path ━━ DNS / PE ━━ injected runtime" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="400" x="84" y="1000" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="footer" parent="1" style="text;html=1;fontSize=14;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontColor=#5A6B7D;" value="VERIFIED: from inside the VNet the Foundry endpoint resolves to 10.0.8.6 and the agent round trip returns PRIVATE_AGENT_PASS. div.div:
1 Runner starts the Job through ARM (public)
2 Job executes INSIDE snet-aca
3 Job calls the backend on its internal FQDN
4 Backend calls the Foundry Agent via private endpoint
5 Agent reads/writes its BYO stores, all private
6 Exit code + console log stream give the verdict
Negative control: the same probes run from the
public runner and MUST fail. That failure is the
evidence the isolation is real.

div.div: VERIFIED: from inside the VNet the Foundry endpoint resolves to 10.0.8.6 and the agent round trip returns PRIVATE_AGENT_PASS. From the public internet the app FQDN does not resolve and the Foundry data plane returns HTTP 403 even with a valid token.
